These establish the active performance of the law as the referent more cleanly and with fewer mediating steps than the common forensic-status reading, which must relegate the same texts to secondary 'fruit/evidence' or 'standard' status. The multi-witness symbolic method and the already-accepted premises (love = keeping commandments; knowing = covenant relationship proven by obedience) further tighten the fit. Secondary claims that absolutely exclude any verdict/status sense, or that fully specify the garment's grant-wash-wear mechanics as indispensable to the identity, remain less secure against the full range of Pauline 'counted/apart-from-works' language and are therefore excluded from FULL support.",
